definitions.explanation: Showing good manners and respect in speech or behavior.
Done with care and attention to detail.

notes:
{丁寧|ていねい} is a na-adjective with two main meanings: "polite" (in manner) and "careful/thorough" (in work).

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {丁寧|ていねい}な + noun
- Adverbial: {丁寧|ていねい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb

SENSE 1 - POLITE:
- {丁寧|ていねい}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: polite language
- {丁寧|ていねい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak politely
- ⟦{丁寧語|ていねいご}→丁寧語：15824_teineigo⟧: polite speech (grammar term for です/ます forms)

SENSE 2 - CAREFUL:
- {丁寧|ていねい}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: careful work
- {丁寧|ていねい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make carefully
- {丁寧|ていねい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to explain thoroughly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乱暴|らんぼう}→乱暴：02482_ranbou⟧: rough, violent (opposite for careful)
- ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧: rude, impolite (opposite for polite)
